Sudden leadership uncertainty tends to raise the equity risk premium and trigger a short-term risk-off move. However, US presidential succession is constitutionally orderly (VP Vance assumes office), so the systemic shock is bounded and policy continuity is likely, which caps the downside relative to a true regime crisis.

llm_justification.summary: The market asks whether Trump will announce resignation by end-2026 — a low-probability tail event. A sharp upward move in its implied probability would plausibly signal acute US political instability, transmitting to a short-term equity risk-off (SPY down) and safe-haven bid (gold up). But the signal is noisy, succession is orderly, and reaching the 700bps tradable threshold within 12h would require confirmed breaking news. Both mappings are low-confidence and likely non-tradable absent corroboration.
key_assumptions: A meaningful move in this market reflects new information rather than thin-market noise.
Acute presidential-transition uncertainty raises equity risk premia in the short run.
Gold and equities respond to US political-institution shocks in the classic risk-off pattern.
failure_modes: The prediction-market move is pure noise/low-liquidity churn with no real information content.
Any resignation is treated as policy-neutral (orderly succession), producing little or even positive equity reaction.
The information is already public/priced by the time it appears in the prediction market.
SPY and GLD are only weakly exposed to this idiosyncratic political event, so the mapping is diluted by macro flows.
Magnitude falls far short of the 700bps tradable threshold, making both predictions non-actionable.
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
